description: This file defines a Pinia store for managing wellbeing entries in a Vue.js frontend application. It provides state variables, asynchronous functions to fetch and add wellbeing data, and exports the store instance.

methods.name: fetchAll
methods.description: Fetches all wellbeing entries from the API and updates the store state.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new wellbeing entry via the API and updates the store items.
